claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item mechanics family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord = SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord has no magic_item variant. The v4 taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom, but src/surface/types.ts has no MagicItemRecord type, no magic_item kind discriminant, and no mechanics family for magic items (no attune procedure plumbing, no charge/use-count pattern for wondrous items, no reaction-trigger-on-incoming-hit shape).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Gloves of Missile Snaring is a Wondrous Item (Requires Attunement) — a magic_item kind that cannot be represented by any existing UnitRecord variant.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core mechanic reduces incoming damage by 1d10 + Dex modifier. None of the existing effect atoms cover this: damage applies outgoing damage, modify_ac is a static AC delta, grant_resistance halves a damage type, modify_roll_numeric modifies a roll rather than the resolved damage total. The taxonomy §11.D explicitly records this as known residue: 'reduce_damage_taken distinct from grant_resistance — single-group pressure from class-feature reactions'. This item adds a second independent pressure stream (magic item reactions).
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger: hit_by_ranged_or_thrown_weapon_attack
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing ReactionTrigger union has hit_by_attack_roll (used by Shield) but carries no weapon-kind filter. This item fires specifically on ranged or thrown weapon attack rolls, not melee or spell attacks. Encoding it as bare hit_by_attack_roll would be dishonest — it would incorrectly cover melee hits. A new variant or sub-filter (weapon_kind: 'ranged_or_thrown') is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon
